owners: Services owns real adapter/configuration/completion vocabulary; runtime assembly owns owning compiler association and existing dispatch/recovery/fence join. Type-only definition adds no runtime resolver/registry, Work dependency or duplicate transport.
availability_contract: Read exact BoundCapabilityRequest logical binding/from/nested arguments from persisted intent; match exact owning appDefinition binding, canonical target and declared capability version. No alias or route/version/account fallback.

Resolve genuinely configured exact deployment. Verify installed deployment/capability/version and actual account before dynamic guard/claim/provider transport. A missing/mismatched installation is explicitly unavailable, not a callback exception or uncertain provider attempt.

Preserve existing committed/inherited-scope/supersession/settled-state precedence and current authority rules. Existing kernel availability can consume a per-intent exact resolver closure; current CF driver lacks actual injection and evaluates readers before the kernel, so the consumer must qualify the needed short-circuit rather than infer it.
Only checked nested arguments reach MailSender.send; original intent.intentId is the stable delivery id for initial call, retries and reconciliation. Never claim ID/new UUID/attempt count.
completion_contract: Validate completion delivery_id matches original intent id. Coherent succeeded EmailAccepted maps to delivered result; definite documented provider rejection maps to closed terminal error; unknown/malformed/unexpected pending or skipped/throw remain uncertain with no ack or blind retry.
MailSender.reconcile is async. Join it deliberately to the current synchronous CF evidence reader or change that reader with corresponding actual callers; never pass a Promise as evidence.

HTTP404 unknown_delivery and invalid_response do not prove provider never saw the request; keep them unknown, not not-found retry permission. Only an actual supported provider guarantee can admit not-found.

CF delivered-state marking currently does not persist provider result. Completion association/result observation remains a separate exact selected consumer gate and must not be credited from a returned drive outcome.
